changelog:
- Added support for the --mine and --role options to list only tasks created or assigned to the current user.
- Clarified that the --tags filter uses OR matching and is rule-based.
- Noted the default page size is now 10 (was 20).
- Updated usage examples to illustrate new filtering features.
